Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 1+1
– Rruga Dalip Topi, Fresk
– Pallat i vitit 2010 pa ashensor
– Kati 2
– Siperfaqja Bruto 64.2m²
– Siperfaqja Neto 54.4m²
– Cmimi 95,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 64.2m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim të një pallati te ri pa ashensor, i pozicionuar ne Rrugen Dalip Topi, Fresk.
Apartamenti ka organizim shume mire, qe perbehet nga korridori, sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 1 dhome gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkoni.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto, eshte i shtruar me parket, ka dyer cilesore, dritare dopio xham dhe tualeti eshte i kompletuar me hidrosanitare.
Disponon dokumetacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe gjithashtu shitet dhe me kredi.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
description_en: Property Features: - 1+1 Apartment - Dalip Topi Street, Fresk - 2010 Building without elevator - 2nd Floor - Gross Area 64.2m² - Net Area 54.4m² - Price 95,000 Euros 1+1 Apartment with an area of 64.2m² for sale, located on the 2nd floor of a new residential building without elevator, located on Dalip Topi Street, Fresk. The apartment has a very good organization, consisting of a corridor, a living room, a kitchen, 1 bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo, it is laid with parquet, it has quality doors, double-glazed windows and the toilet is complete with plumbing. It has regular mortgage documentation and is also sold on credit. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
